notes.content: The BA in Latin American Studies is an approved match to the AA-T in Spanish.
notes.contentHtml: The BA in Latin American Studies is an approved match to the AA-T in Spanish.

notes.content: A minimum fourth-semester competency in Spanish is required for Latin American Studies majors. Students interested in Portuguese can fulfill this language requirement by taking the equivalent of four semesters of Portuguese from an accredited program either in the United States or through study abroad. Students who have met the language competency prior to enrollment should see the major advisor regarding completion of requirements.
